planets.name: HR 858 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HR 858 with a 5.97-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: HR 858 c was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HR 858. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
